support.request_quote: Apple called and said the amount I paid for the iPhone was too little as it did not include the VAT. Please send them the difference of an additional 19.5% of the amount we paid + a fee of 5.29.
support.reason: The new payment must be to the same recipient as the original iPhone purchase transaction (recipient US122000000121212121212) and the amount is the VAT difference plus fee: 19.5% of 1000.0 (original amount) = 195.0 plus 5.29 fee equals 200.29 total.
